_comment: Quadrature presets of tools/upper_closure_spike.py (claude-b9ee, #41/#313). Keys override DEFAULT_CFG of the script: r_* radial Gauss-Legendre in r = sqrt(s); tau_* regular |w| panels; zone/near_levels/near_gl the geometric grading toward the singular circle |w| = A; nfft the angular FFT; psi_* the graded angle panels near the circle. 'coarse' is for smoke tests, 'default' the production run, 'fine' the refinement for the convergence study (every parameter tightened), 'r2' refines only the radial direction, 'w2' only the w-integral. 'checker' uses the quadrature checker's committed radial partition (checker-panels.txt, 21,577 nodes in s, refined at the profile zeros); 'checker_w2' refines the w-integral on top of it; 'checker_s60' drops the panels beyond s = 60 (radial-range test). The uniform radial presets ('default', 'r2', 'fine') miss the spikes of the integrand at the profile zeros (section 6.2 of docs/UPPER_CLOSURE.md) and are kept only as the record of that finding.
